description: This file defines a Flutter page for editing notes, including UI widgets and state management for creating and updating notes. It also includes navigation arguments.

classes.name: NoteEditArgs
classes.description: A class representing navigation arguments for the note editing page, indicating whether it's an edit operation and the note ID.

classes.name: NoteEditPage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the UI for editing or creating a note.

classes.name: _NoteEditPageState
classes.description: State class handling the UI logic, form controls, and interactions for the NoteEditPage.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes controllers and loads existing note data if editing.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the page, including form fields and action buttons.

methods.name: _onSave
methods.description: Handles the save action, either updating an existing note or creating a new one.
